name: com.delightroom.daro.unity
description: Daro ad mediation adapter for Unity (MAX variant). Supports Android and iOS.
_dependencies_note: EDM4U (com.google.external-dependency-manager@1.2.186) is the real transitive dep, re-introduced in Phase 3 when Dependencies.xml Force Resolve is exercised. Phase 5 Integration Manager auto-injects the Google scoped registry into the consumer's manifest.json. During Phases 1-4 the dep is omitted so the sample project can resolve without manual registry setup.
